attrs.evidence: bridge/film_check.mjs 45/45. B-1: church_exp_2_2 under --budget 3 seals 3 honest frames with remaining_work 4 against a 21-frame full film, replayed on FloatRt and DescFloatRt, and its frames are byte-identical to the unbudgeted film's first three -- the budget TRUNCATED the execution rather than altering it. B-2: --budget 0 seals a zero-frame film, last_frame genesis, remaining_work 1, final state EQUAL to the full film's frame-0 pre-state and no normal_form field -- the exact shape the round-6B audit forged, now GENERATED honestly and judged by the repaired schema. B-3: --budget 20 -> BUDGET_EXHAUSTED with 1 enabled, --budget 21 -> NORMAL_FORM byte-identical to the unbudgeted film. B-4: budgets 0,1,3,10,20,21 all replay on both runtime classes and every one's frames are a prefix of the whole; remaining_work is NOT monotone in the budget (1,2,4,2,1) and is re-derived per film rather than predicted. B-5: on church 4^4 the same term refuses film-locus-path-too-deep unbudgeted and yields an honest 5-frame partial film under --budget 5 -- a storage refusal and an execution terminal out of one term; --budget -1 refuses film-budget-negative. Six resealed terminal forgeries die on their own reasons: inflated work (sem-terminal-work-mismatch), budget lie (sem-budget-mismatch), partial claiming NORMAL_FORM (sem-false-normal-form), wrong final state (sem-terminal-state-mismatch), the COMPLETE film relabelled BUDGET_EXHAUSTED (sem-terminal-work-mismatch, because a quiescent state has no honest remaining_work at all), and pool narrowing. The narrowing is SEARCHED FOR rather than chosen: the pool is cut by exactly one rule that no frame fires and that changes the enabled count, so the attack cannot die on sem-plane-not-permitted at frame 2 while the work arithmetic never runs -- the coincidental-second-occurrence species, caught for the fifth time in this line. B-12: the budget argument is parsed strictly IN THE BINARY -- 11 value cases and 3 argument-shape cases, each answered by name. B5 shipped strtol(arg, NULL, 10), which reads as far as it can and reports nothing about the rest, so --budget abc emitted a valid zero-frame film under a policy nobody set, 3junk parsed as 3, 1.5 truncated, and an overflow had ERANGE ignored so the malformed request came back a COMPLETE 21-frame NORMAL_FORM film -- a confident complete answer to a different question. endptr AND errno now, plus a leading whitespace/'+' check strtol performs in silence; film-budget-invalid for malformed syntax and film-budget-negative kept SEPARATE for a well-formed out-of-range policy, because one code for both cannot say whether to fix a value or fix a spelling. B-13: film-too-many-frames is witnessed by a -DMAXFRAMES=4 LIMITS BUILD refusing on the same fixture the production build completes, with the production ceilings reported by the BINARY (--limits) rather than grepped from the #define, since under an override the source and the program disagree. PRODUCTION REACHABILITY IS STATED SEPARATELY AND WEAKLY, which is the honest form: no term tried reaches the frame array, because MAXPATH binds first on every one of them. B5 first wrote that the frame array COULD NOT be reached -- an unproven universal over every expressible term where the evidence supports only a statement about the terms measured.
attrs.statement: THE EXECUTION PLANE ORIGINATES EVIDENCE FOR THE INTERACTION-NET DYNAMICS THEMSELVES, rather than the governance plane reconstructing it around the execution plane afterwards. For a frozen fixture, the native C runtime independently emits a chained semantic film whose per-frame pre-state, enabled rule, PLANE, canonical locus and post-state, and whose terminal, are accepted by the existing TRVM-SEMFILM-v1.1 contract WITHOUT normalization or translation of meaning -- the law kernel's own replaySemFilm, imported unmodified, replaying on a fresh runtime of two different allocator classes. @1 SCOPED THIS TO THE APP PLANE and that was the whole frontier: application of a lambda at a tree locus is the part of the calculus a term-rewriting relation already models. @2 IS THE FLOAT PLANE. Enumeration covers the root tree AND EVERY LIVE DUP CELL; loci are canonical in three families -- t: a structural path, d: a DISCOVERY INDEX over live cells, v: a discovery index AND a path into a cell's value -- and AT @3 EVERY RULE OF THE DECLARED POOL HAS A POSITIVE NATIVE WITNESS: APP-LAM, APP-SUP, APP-ERA, DUP-LAM, DUP-SUP=, DUP-SUP!, DUP-ERA, DUP-VAR and DUP-APP. THE TWO ORDERS ARE DIFFERENT ORDERS AND BOTH ARE LOAD-BEARING: the kernel enumerates live cells right-to-left (liveHeap pushes children forward) and INDEXES loci left-to-right (liveDiscoveryOrder pushes them reversed), so one order decides which redex is leftmost and the other decides what number its locus carries; collapsing either onto the other produces a locus that names a real redex which is not the redex that fired. SCOPE, CHECKED RATHER THAN ASSUMED AND STATED AS REFUSALS: an enumerated rule the emitter cannot fire is REFUSED BY NAME (film-rule-not-implemented) rather than silently skipped, and the pool is enumerated in full regardless of what is implemented -- so that 'no enabled work' cannot mean 'no work of the kinds I implement', which is how a false normal form is written down. THE SCOPE PREDICATE HAS MOVED FOUR TIMES AND EVERY MOVE WAS A CORRECTION (dup PRESENCE, dup ENABLEDNESS, the two ERA rules, and now nothing rule-shaped at all), so the law and its checks name the DURABLE property rather than the current gap. THE ERA RULES CLOSED BY CONSTRUCTION, NOT BY DISCOVERY: two purpose-built minimal fixtures -- (* x) is one APP-ERA frame, and !{a,b} = *; lambda z.a is one DUP-ERA frame with a SINGLE live projection, which also exercises the one-sided path through find_projections -- rather than one contrived term that happens to contain both. The conformance corpus contains NO ERA at all, which is why all 24 vectors could agree while two of nine rules had never run natively, and why these had to be BUILT rather than found. AND CANONICAL LOCUS ASSIGNMENT IS INJECTIVE OVER SEMANTIC REDEX IDENTITY: one redex gets at most one canonical locus. The representation makes an alias EXPRESSIBLE -- each findAppRedexes call carries its own visited set, so a node reachable both from the root and from inside a dup value is enumerable under a t: AND a v: locus -- and since the locus is committed into frame_id, two spellings of one transition would be two canonical frame identities for the same pre, rule and post. Identity is PHYSICAL and per-runtime and is therefore NOT a cross-implementation field: each side checks its own. Nothing in the measured fixtures produces an alias; the emitter REFUSES film-locus-alias rather than blessing both spellings, because precedence between them is UNRULED and choosing one silently would decide a rule nobody wrote down. THE ONE-INTERACTION GUARD IS POST-HOC BY RULING AND STAYS SO: it measures what the shipped runtime DID, including any future change inside fire() or whnf(), where a structural pre-check could only measure what is predicted. Its soundness depends on the emitter being FAIL-STOP -- a refusal exits, so a heap mutated before the guard fired never becomes accepted evidence, and a persistent service would need transactional scratch state. The PREDICTION behind it is measured separately rather than left as prose: whnf is INERT on every head class the one classifier admits, at interaction delta 0 AND canonical semantic state unchanged -- the second clause being the one a counter alone would miss, since whnf memoizes a stuck application's reduced head without counting an interaction. No second inline classifier was added to do this; two semantic recognizers can drift. A STEP BUDGET REACHED WHILE WORK REMAINS IS A SEALED TERMINAL AND NO LONGER A REFUSAL -- CHANGED AT B5, AND THE DISTINCTION IT MAKES PORTABLE IS EPISTEMIC. NORMAL_FORM says there is provably no work left; BUDGET_EXHAUSTED says we stopped looking and this much was left. A runtime that cannot separate them cannot be trusted with either, and until v0.5.0 C could originate only the first: reaching a budget produced film-budget-exhausted, which reports the ABSENCE of evidence where the truth is evidence of a partial run. NO NEW CONTRACT WAS INTRODUCED TO DO IT. TRVM-SEMFILM-v1.1 has carried the budget witness since round 6.1, when the round-6B audit falsified v1's terminal by forging a zero-frame BUDGET_EXHAUSTED film over an enabled state that replayed ok with budget and remaining_work outside the commitment entirely; law:film.terminal-witness@1 closed that at the SCHEMA level, and B5 supplies only the ORIGINATOR. C seals {termination, steps, last_frame, final_sem_id, budget, remaining_work, planes}, every field inside film_id and every field RE-DERIVED by replay on two runtime classes. THE TERMINAL IS NOT A TRANSITION: budget describes the state at the moment a further step was DENIED, so no synthetic frame is appended and remaining_work is measured on the state the last real frame left behind. NORMAL_FORM TAKES PRECEDENCE AT THE BOUNDARY, AND THE RULE IS AN ORDERING RATHER THAN A COMPARISON: the terminal is concluded only after a FRESH FULL-POOL ENUMERATION, and an empty pool is a normal form even on the step where the budget ran out. Reading steps == budget as exhaustion would report a completed execution as an abandoned one -- an under-claim, still false, and a proof consumer believing it would keep searching a space that is already closed. AND ONE QUANTITY CROSSES IMPLEMENTATIONS FOR THE FIRST TIME: every native film before this asked the oracle to agree about STATES -- canonical signatures, chains, normal forms. remaining_work is a COUNT, the cardinality of C's fresh full-pool enumeration, and two enumerators that agree about every state they visit can still disagree about how many redexes a state contains; nothing before this round would have noticed. A PARTIAL FILM CARRIES NO NORMAL FORM -- reading one back performs exactly the work the budget denied and reports it beside a terminal saying it was not done -- so normal_form and normal_form_id are ABSENT rather than present-and-to-be-ignored. THE SEMANTIC BUDGET AND THE STORAGE CEILING STAY DISTINCT: --budget N is execution policy and yields evidence, MAXFRAMES is this program's frame array and yields only a refusal, and they coincide numerically at the default -- which is precisely the condition under which two concepts get merged by accident. THE CEILINGS ARE COMPILE-TIME OVERRIDABLE so the guard can be witnessed without moving it: raising a production resource bound to make another production resource bound easier to hit in a test changes the implementation under test to improve the test surface. A defensive resource ceiling is not a semantic refusal and does not owe the same coverage -- mechanism witness and production reachability are two claims and are asserted separately. AND THE RELATION WAS MEASURED BEFORE IT WAS ASSERTED. The C reducer was built with a non-gating --measure formatter and diffed against the independently measured kernel relation over the whole 24-vector corpus and the film fixtures before one conformance assertion existed; NO EXPECTED TABLE APPEARS IN THE EMITTER OR IN THE COMPARATOR, because a conformance theorem whose expected values were transcribed from the other implementation is a TRANSCRIPTION THEOREM. ic32 CANNOT SUBSTITUTE A DUP BY NAME and that cost is representational, not semantic: heap[D] is the cell's value before the rule fires and the other side's substitution afterwards, so a dup is fired from a DEMANDED SIDE and the demanded projection is replaced where it stands, found by a walk over reachable slots that REFUSES (film-projection-not-unique) rather than choosing if it is not unique. The rules fired are ic32's own fire() and app_sup(), unedited. THE TWO TRANSITION SYSTEMS STAY SEPARATE (film_planes): the TRVM calculus film is pre-state -> (rule + locus) -> post-state over the ic32 interaction-net relation, and the derivation evidence relation is DeriveRequest -> evaluate -> DeriveResult; what is shared is HOST INFRASTRUCTURE, not semantics. Film provenance uses the same discipline as derivation.implementation-provenance@4 -- shared ObservedExecutionHost, immutable catalog entry, hash-then-launch, observation keyed over the whole emission -- and REPLAY AND PROVENANCE ARE REPORTED SEPARATELY, because a film can be semantically perfect and its claimed provenance false.
